options.name: api_host
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the pfSense device.

options.name: api_key
options.description: An API key to use for authentication.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: api_port
options.description: The port number of the pfSense API.

options.name: api_protocol
options.description: The protocol to use when connecting to the pfSense API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: caref
options.description: The certificate authority to use as the parent for this intermediate certificate authority.

options.name: descr
options.description: The descriptive name for this certificate authority.

options.name: digest_alg
options.description: The digest algorithm to use when signing certificates.

options.name: dn_city
options.description: The city for the certificate authority.

options.name: dn_commonname
options.description: The common name for the certificate authority.

options.name: dn_country
options.description: The country for the certificate authority.

options.name: dn_organization
options.description: The organization for the certificate authority.

options.name: dn_organizationalunit
options.description: The organizational unit for the certificate authority.

options.name: dn_state
options.description: The state for the certificate authority.

options.name: ecname
options.description: The name of the elliptic curve to use for the ECDSA key pair.

options.name: is_intermediate
options.description: Indicates if this certificate authority is an intermediate certificate authority.

options.name: keylen
options.description: The length of the RSA key pair to generate.

options.name: keytype
options.description: The type of key pair to generate.

options.name: lifetime
options.description: The number of days the certificate authority is valid for.

options.name: randomserial
options.description: Enables or disables the randomization of serial numbers for certificates signed by this CA.

options.name: trust
options.description: Adds or removes this certificate authority from the operating system's trust stored.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when connecting to the API.
